subject: Fix return types of three module API declarations to match definitions (#4676)
reason: The change only corrects three function-pointer declarations in valkeymodule.h from void to int so they match the definitions in module.c, which already returned int (module.c:10480, 10751, 10765), and adds a doc comment. No executable server code changes: modules resolve these APIs by name at load time and the return-value ABI is unaffected, so both builds behave identically at runtime and no scenario can reach a behavioral difference.
